text:
Jason: quick capacity check — we need 4 x A100-40 in apac1 for a midnight canary tomorrow (00:30 SGT). Can we borrow from the demo pool or request a short burst? cc @Priya @Lee
Priya: which exact zone/region is apac1 here? ap-southeast1? also how long do you expect the run to be?
Jason: apac1 = asia-southeast1 (cloud vendor). estimate ~90m end-to-end (warmup + tests). it's to validate new KV cache + batching config.
Lee: we currently have 2 spare A100-40 in apac1 until 22:00 SGT for demos. after that only 1 spare. vendor burst quota might give temporary slots. fallback could be H100-80 if latency OK :thinking_face:
Matt: dropping to H100 with the quantized variant should be fine for perf. will need a runtime flag switch in the canary: MODEL_VARIANT=h100-qdq. I can prepare the PR for the rollout.
Jason: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321 — includes tf snippet to request temporary quota bump. @Sarah can infra ops approve if vendor is OK?
Sarah: on it. quick Q — do you need persistent IPs for the canary or can it use ephemeral instances? ephemeral makes vendor provisioning faster. also please tag with `canary/nightly-apac` for billing.
InfraBot: Quota request created: QR-2026-1123. Tracker: https://infra.redwood/quotas/QR-2026-1123 :white_check_mark:
Priya: if the quota doesn't land by 23:00 SGT plan B is to run the canary from us-west with 2 x A100 + network-shim. adds ~40ms setup overhead but still useful for regression checks.
Lee: I'll try to reassign 2 demo A100s after 22:30; Matt, can you validate the h100 variant in dev tonight? if that passes we can swap quickly.
Matt: can run a smoke at 20:00 SGT and post logs. ping me if you want results merged into the canary branch.
Jason: thanks — if QR approved I'll patch infra with this tf snippet tonight:
```hcl
resource "redwood_quota" "apac_tmp" {
  region = "apac1"
  gpu    = "A100-40"
  count  = 4
  duration = "2h"
  tags   = ["canary/nightly-apac"]
}
```
Sarah: approving once InfraBot surfaces vendor ETA. :thumbsup:
InfraBot: Vendor update: VendorX reports 'In stock' for 4 A100-40 in apac1; provisioning ETA 45 minutes after approval. Vendor ticket VEND-9987.
Jason: last call — any objections to 00:30 SGT start? if no replies, I'll proceed with the plan and update the runbook.
Lee: :thumbsup: go ahead.
Priya: :thumbsup:
Matt: 👍
Jason: thanks all — will post final when QR-2026-1123 is green.
